brief.headline: Broad selloff with extreme single-stock anomalies despite low VIX

stance.label: Cautious / Neutral
stance.summary: Market regime is CAUTIOUS / NEUTRAL at 49/100, with broad selloff participation and weak breadth.

overview.text: SPY fell 0.4% and DIA fell 0.5%, while IWM rose 0.2% and QQQ was unchanged.
Breadth is extremely weak: only 0.3% of constituents above 20-day MA and 0.5% above 50-day MA, with 5 new 20-day highs vs 23 new lows.
Several large-cap stocks experienced extreme volatility shocks, including FICO and LULU.

keyDrivers.title: Regulatory / Legal Catalysts
keyDrivers.text: EFX and FICO both had strong regulatory/legal catalysts, with FICO falling 16.7% and EFX falling 6.4%.

keyDrivers.title: Guidance Catalyst
keyDrivers.text: LULU's strongest matched catalyst is GUIDANCE with strong evidence, and the stock fell 17.4%.

keyDrivers.title: Management Catalyst
keyDrivers.text: ADBE's strongest matched catalyst is MANAGEMENT with moderate evidence, and the stock fell 6.7%.

keyDrivers.title: Inflation Pressure from Oil
keyDrivers.text: WTI rose 5.1%, increasing inflation pressure, which is a negative regime driver.

keyDrivers.title: Low VIX and Cyclical Outperformance
keyDrivers.text: VIX is low at 14.3 and fell 5.8%, while cyclicals outperformed defensives by 0.35pp, providing some positive offset.
